title: LETTER 14: Letter to NABARD — Request for Agricultural Infrastructure Fund

blocks.content: Topic: You are the CEO of a Farmers' Producer Organisation (FPO). Write a letter to NABARD requesting financial assistance for setting up a cold storage and agro-processing unit.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Address the official request directly to the Chief General Manager of the respective NABARD Regional Office.
Clearly state the nature of the agricultural infrastructure project, total estimated outlay, and intended location.
Highlight the alignment of the project with Agri Infrastructure Fund (AIF) guidelines, emphasizing post-harvest management and community assets.
Detail the financial viability, expected social impact, and benefits accruing to local farming communities.

blocks.content: Saurashtra Groundnut Farmers' Producer Company Limited,
We request financial assistance under the Agricultural Infrastructure Fund to establish post-harvest management infrastructure.
Subject: Application for Financial Assistance Under Agricultural Infrastructure Fund (AIF) for Cold Storage and Processing Unit

I write on behalf of Saurashtra Groundnut Farmers' Producer Company Limited, a Farmers' Producer Organisation (FPO) registered under the Companies Act 2013, representing 2,847 small and marginal groundnut farmers across 14 villages in Rajkot and Morbi districts of Gujarat. Our FPO was established in 2020 under the PM FPO Scheme with the support of NAFED, and we are delighted to report that our collective turnover has grown from Rs. 1.8 crore in our first year to Rs. 6.2 crore in 2023-24.

Despite this progress, our member farmers lose an estimated 18–22% of their produce value each year due to the complete absence of post-harvest infrastructure in our area. Groundnut, being a perishable oil-seed, requires temperature-controlled storage to prevent moisture damage and aflatoxin contamination — a major barrier to premium market access and export. Currently, our produce is sold within days of harvest at distress prices to commission agents, while the same produce, after storage and processing, fetches nearly 40% higher prices in the market.

We respectfully request financial assistance under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) and NABARD's FPO promotion schemes for the following: (i) a cold storage facility of 500 MT capacity (estimated cost: Rs. 80 lakh); (ii) a groundnut oil-pressing and packaging unit (estimated cost: Rs. 45 lakh); and (iii) a digital weighing, quality testing, and market linkage infrastructure (estimated cost: Rs. 12 lakh). Our FPO is prepared to contribute 15% of project cost from its own funds and member contributions. We request a loan for the remaining amount at the concessional rate available under AIF (3% interest subvention).

A detailed project report, audited accounts of the FPO, and registration documents are enclosed herewith. We sincerely hope that your esteemed organisation will consider our application favourably and help our farmer-members realise the true value of their hard work.

items: Ensure precise adherence to formal business letter formatting (Sender Address, Date, Recipient Designation, Subject, Salutation, Body, Sign-off) as tested in Descriptive English exams.
Include key technical terms like 'Interest Subvention', 'Credit Guarantee', and 'Post-Harvest Management' to gain higher evaluation marks in banking examinations.
Maintain a professional, objective, and persuasive tone focused on agricultural sustainability and economic viability.

blocks.content: Examiner's Tip: FPO-related letters demonstrate awareness of a rapidly growing area in agri-banking. Show specific numbers (2,847 members, Rs.6.2 crore turnover, 18-22% post-harvest losses). The project cost breakdown and contribution offer show financial prudence.
